function.description: Read ONE Jupiter prediction EVENT by its eventId. Use this when you already hold an eventId and want the question itself, or the list of tradable markets under it - solana__predict_events_discover browses, solana__predict_events_search finds one by keyword. Returns the event's eventId, category, curated metadata (title, subtitle) and volumeUsd as an exact-decimal USD string with a raw volumeUsdMicro sibling; pass includeMarkets to also fetch its nested markets, each carrying the marketId that solana__predict_market_get and the trade tools take, plus title, status, result, openTime, closeTime, resolveAt and pricing. The result is complete: there is no paging on a single event.
function.name: solana__predict_event_get

includeMarkets.description: Include the event's nested markets array (default false - lean).
